jobs.title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
jobs.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract. What you'll be doing People Operations Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle. Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution. Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early. Own payroll input end to end: collate,

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist- H/F
jobs.description: MARGO MARGO est une société de consulting en Data, IA et Ingénierie logicielle créée en 2005. Présente en France et à l’international, nous réunissons les meilleurs experts pour répondre aux missions techniques les plus intéressantes auprès des clients les plus exigeants. Aujourd’hui, MARGO ambitionne de devenir un acteur majeur de l’IA, à consolider sa présence chez ses clients et à étendre son positionnement haut de gamme auprès de nouveaux acteurs du marché. CONTEXTE DE RECRUTEMENT Dans un contexte de forte accélération, nous renforçons notre équipe Talent Acquisition. Le rôle de Talent Acquisition Specialist est clé : vous identifiez les meilleurs potentiels, vous les recrutez et vous les accompagnez jusqu’à leur intégration. Un poste stratégique, polyvalent et fondamental pour la croissance de MARGO. VOS MISSIONS EN TANT QUE TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST Recrutement : Définition des besoins en étroite collaboration avec les Business Manager Développement d’une stratégie de recherche des profils en choisissant les canaux adaptés Chasse et entretien du vivier des candidatures Animation des entretiens d’embauche en autonomie Gestion du processus de recrutement Négociation salariale Intégration : Gestion de l’intégration du collaborateur chez Margo Mise en place de coachings Suivi de l’intégration Gestion de projets RH : Animation des relations écoles : participation aux forums, conférences et ateliers Intervenir sur des projets RH (onboarding, refonte du processus de recrutement, offboarding…) Être Talent Acquisition Specialist chez MARGO c’est aussi faire le choix : De ne pas se cantonner à une seule étape du processus de recrutement De travailler avec différents interlocuteurs De pouvoir évoluer dans en environnement dynamique et challengeant De recruter des profils à forte valeur ajoutée D’une entreprise qui valorise son capital humain L'ÉQUIPE MARGO Vous allez être managé par un Talent Acquisition Manager qui a déjà fait ses preuves sur le métier de recruteur.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Our approach is simple because our purpose informs everything we do: We exist to be the trusted solution for our clients as they strive to build a better working world and improve human experience. At CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally: We act with integrity We serve each other We serve society We work for our future At CAI, we believe in a relentless dedication to excellence, pushing boundaries, and surpassing expectations. We operate at the intersection of wisdom and technology and thrive when they come together with humanity. For us, operational readiness isn’t simply a goal. It’s a way of life. Because tomorrow demands to be at the forefront of today. We do this through tireless effort, precision, efficiency, and an unwavering belief that there is always room for advancement. We’re not interested in how it used to be done. We’re obsessed with how it will be done. We are seeking an experienced Recruiter to join our People Solutions Team and support our Life Sciences hiring in the Asia Pacific region.
